title: Compare nonadjacent USA shop recording replay
platforms: Windows GNU under Wine/Xvfb and Linux interpreter replay model
changes: Record a nonadjacent USA shop category change and compare key-only against modeled semantic replay.
validation: The real 411-frame recording contains mouse:1028 and verifier rejects it. Key-only replay differed from the captured endpoint; modeled-event replay matched the recorded serialized state and clock. Protected input hashes unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic pointer movement and click were combined; modeled replay bypassed the parser and dispatcher. No actual successful application replay, native Windows, Android or broad category coverage.
Managed cleanup rejects U31 units; private diagnostic evidence remains isolated.
